description: This source file contains functions for automating various stock-related operations within the ERPNext framework, including creating purchase receipts, delivery notes, stock reconciliations, and handling returns. It orchestrates stock workflows and interactions with ERPNext's DocType models.

methods.name: work()
methods.description: Main orchestrator function that sets the user and triggers various stock operations such as creating purchase receipts, delivery notes, reconciliations, and returns.

methods.name: make_purchase_receipt()
methods.description: Creates purchase receipt documents based on a report result, with some probabilistic selection, and handles negative stock errors.

methods.name: make_delivery_note()
methods.description: Creates delivery notes from sales order reports, assigns expense accounts if missing, and manages exceptions related to stock issues.

methods.name: make_stock_reconciliation()
methods.description: Performs stock reconciliation with random modifications, handling potential errors related to stock and accounts.

methods.name: submit_draft_stock_entries()
methods.description: Attempts to submit older draft stock entries, handling exceptions related to stock errors and permissions.

methods.name: make_sales_return_records()
methods.description: Generates sales return records from delivered orders probabilistically, with error handling.

methods.name: make_purchase_return_records()
methods.description: Produces purchase return records from received purchase receipts probabilistically, with error handling.
